notes: Alignment operates on TEXT_OPEN/TEXT_CLOSE-local dialogue sessions rather than assuming whole-event Android monotonicity.
Dynamic PLAYER_NAME commands are normalized to Android %S(index,0) placeholders for comparison only.
French is recovered through complete English-anchor localization intervals after English identity is established.
Exact duplicate Android locations may be translation-equivalent without having unique provenance; alternatives remain explicit.
Unmatched or ambiguous SNES prose is retained as unmapped and is never forced onto the nearest candidate.
SNES wrapping/page/layout formatting is a separate later step; Android French prose is not written to translations/dialogues_french.json here.

mappings.french_display: C'est bon, vous pouvez passer !

mappings.source_display:
NOBLEMAN:King Truffle
 is a splendid ruler!
mappings.android_english_display: Nobleman: King Truffle is a splendid ruler!
mappings.french_display: Ministre : Sa Majesté le roi Truffaut a dignement succédé à son prédécesseur.

mappings.source_display: However, he's reckless!
mappings.android_english_display: However, he's reckless!
mappings.french_display: Mais il est parfois quelque peu... téméraire. Il me cause bien du souci.

mappings.source_display:
Our ancestors once rode
 flying animals.
 White dragons, I believe!
mappings.android_english_display: Our ancestors once rode flying animals. White dragons, I believe!
mappings.french_display: On dit que nos ancêtres parcouraient les cieux sur le dos de créatures volantes. Des sortes de dragons blancs... mais on raconte qu'ils sont éteints aujourd'hui.

mappings.source_display:
Amazingly, a white dragon
 was spotted yesterday in
 a cave to the north!
mappings.android_english_display: Amazingly, a white dragon was spotted yesterday in a cave to the north!
mappings.french_display: Pourtant, l'un des nôtres a aperçu un dragon blanc dans la grotte du nord, hier !

mappings.source_display:
Legend has it that a Mana
Beast took on the Fortress.
mappings.android_english_display: Legend has it that a Mana Beast took on the Fortress.
mappings.french_display: La légende parle d'un conflit entre les bénévodons et la Forteresse qui aurait dévasté le monde.

mappings.source_display:
Animals similar to Mana
beasts live in our world!
mappings.android_english_display: Animals similar to Mana Beasts live in our world!
mappings.french_display: Il existe des dragons sacrés qui ressemblent à ces bénévodons.

mappings.source_display:
Sometimes you see them
flying through the woods.
mappings.android_english_display: Sometimes you see them flying through the woods.
mappings.french_display: On les aperçoit parfois volant dans les forêts.

mappings.source_display:
I saw a white dragon!
They're supposed to be
extinct!
mappings.french_display: Je n'en reviens pas ! J'ai vu un dragon blanc dans la grotte de la montagne... On les croyait disparus !

mappings.source_display:
WATTS:Whew! I thought you'd

mappings.android_english_display: Watts: Whew! I thought you'd already left!
mappings.french_display: Watts : Vous en avez mis du temps ! J'étais sûr que vous passeriez par ici...

mappings.source_display: This man's told me allabout you.
mappings.android_english_display: This man's told me all about you.
mappings.french_display: Cet homme vient de me raconter vos aventures.

mappings.source_display: NOBLEMAN:You ARE the knight!
mappings.android_english_display: Nobleman: You ARE the knight!

mappings.source_display:
A vile serpent took our
 last king.
mappings.android_english_display: A vile serpent took our last king._

mappings.source_display: Welcome to Matango!
mappings.android_english_display: Welcome to Matango!
mappings.french_display: Bienvenue au Royaume de Matango !

mappings.source_display:
Unlike others of our kind,
we're peaceful!
mappings.android_english_display: Unlike others of our kind, we're peaceful!
mappings.french_display: Contrairement à nos cousins les Mycobombes, nous autres habitants de Matango sommes pacifiques.

mappings.source_display:
This is Fung Castle, home
of King Truffle.
mappings.android_english_display: This is Fung Castle, home of King Truffle.

mappings.source_display:
The forest has become a
dangerous place...
mappings.android_english_display: The forest has become a dangerous place...
mappings.french_display: La forêt est fort agitée ces temps-ci. C'est peut-être un mauvais présage.

mappings.source_display:
We say “MATANGO” to greet
each other!

mappings.android_english_display: Not leaving yet, I hope!

We aren't equipped to fight
monsters.

mappings.source_display:
I'm sure King Truffle can
help you!
